title: Yoisaki Kanade — A Cup For You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Meeting Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Voice
rows.Line: So, is this the place...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika's Voice
rows.Line: I think so. Minori just messaged me saying that their group just finished doing their meeting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade, Ichika, welcome!
We were just getting ready for our practice tea party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, pardon us...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Pardon us.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Umm... Hanasato? Momoi?
Thank you both for finding a place where we can practice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll do better than I've done in the past, but I'm starting to wonder if I'll be able to prepare our tea properly during the actual thing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
That's completely understandable!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, since we'll be at a park, we won't be using quite the same things as here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, let's just do our best today to simulate the real thing!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My initial hope was that they'd just give us a little advice, but they've gone out of their way to put together a practice tea party...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That means I need to do what I can to learn how to prepare the best tea I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we're all set to go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, the water's boiling, so we can start steeping the tea.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll give it a try this time as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How's the teapot...? Okay, it should be warm enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just put in enough tea leaves for one person for this taste test.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, we'll need to make the most of the water in our kettle during the day of, so we should see how our tea turns out after the hot water's cooled down a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, enough tea leaves for one person...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll need to steep yours for two minutes, Kanade, and mine needs four, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? I didn't realize each type of tea had to be steeped for a different amount of time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it apparently depends on the size and length of the leaves.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kanade's tea leaves don't take very long to steep because they're so thin. Mine are much bigger, which means steeping them for longer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That reminds me, I've heard that it's much better to use glass teapots like this one.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, because they allow you to see how the color of the water changes and the way the leaves are moving.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The way they're moving...? Oh, they're spinning around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. The tea leaves “jump” because of convection.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I've heard that before!
The tea's supposed to taste better after they've spun around a lot, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Go, go, tea leaves!
MORE MORE JUMPING!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, not so close to the table!
You don't wanna ruin the groove by shaking it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I'm sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It smells nice...
But it tastes a little bitter...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try using less of the leaves or not steeping it for as long?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We can just keep making adjustments like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can you tell me what you think of this herbal tea?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, it smells so nice and fresh...!
This aroma makes me feel really healthy for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And it tastes great!
You can definitely stick to whatever you just did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Momoi, Hanasato...
Thank you for tasting everything for us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We feel much better about our tea party now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm glad we could help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's make this tea party a great one!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes.
Let's!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, as much as I hate to say this, it's time to start cleaning everything up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, actually, before I forget...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Before you forget what, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... I bought some cookies to go with our tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'd completely forgotten about them until now because I was so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You bought cookies?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's have them now!
We still have a bit of tea left.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can we, Kanade? I was actually just starting to get a little hungry!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Would you like some as well, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm... Tea and sweets. What more can you ask for?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, these are so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm so glad we got a chance to practice for our tea party.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And I want to do my best for everyone when this happens for real.)
